summary: Add trello-sync command that hydrates the local store via member->boards->cards/lists/members/actions/checklists.
reason: Trello has no top-level bulk-list endpoint, so the generic sync pulled 0 records. The cross-board analytics need a populated store.
validated_outcome: trello-sync mirrored all open boards, their cards, lists, members, and recent actions into local SQLite.
